# Champion Tokens (CT) — Full System Architecture, Security & Safety Documentation

## 1. Safety, Legitimacy & Privacy Architecture
- **Authentication Method**: Official Discord OAuth 2.0 (RFC 6749). Tokens and user profiles are tied to public Discord IDs. The platform does not collect, handle, or store user passwords or login credentials.
- **Epic Games Display Identification**: Epic Games usernames (IGNs) are public player identifiers used strictly for in-game Fortnite Creative party invites. No Epic Games authentication tokens, passwords, or private account data are ever requested or stored.
- **Skill-Based Competition Policy**: Champion Tokens operates strictly as a skill-based esports matchmaking organizer. Outcomes in Fortnite Creative (Realistic, Zone Wars, Box Fights) depend 100% on individual physical player execution and gaming skill.
- **Dispute Resolution & Anti-Cheat**: 24/7 moderation staff review submitted match replay files and screen captures. Fraudulent claims result in immediate account termination.
- **Starter Balance**: 1.00 complimentary CT starter token provided to new accounts for free platform testing.

## 2. Platform Modules
- **Lobby Coordinator**: Real-time lobby generation with auto-expiring match rooms and 6-character room codes.
- **Real-Time Database Ledger**: Google Cloud Firebase Firestore with atomic transaction locking (`db.runTransaction`) verifying balance integrity.
- **Shop & Wardrobe Engine**: Daily rotating cosmetics (12 Avatars and 12 Titles) seeded by UTC date with instant wardrobe equipping.
- **Security Perimeter**: Cloudflare Edge protection, Content Security Policy, rate-limiting, and automated bot prevention.
